description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to pay grade currencies in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties and methods to set and retrieve a pay grade ID, along with constants specifying allowed sort fields and parameter names.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering pay grade currency search results, including pay grade ID and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'ct.name'.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the pay grade ID for filtering.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves the pay grade ID used in filtering.
